title: Settings that know they changed
description:
Keep a settings struct, notice edits, and offer Apply and Revert.

```
edit volume 0.8 -> 0.5  (unsaved changes: 1)
edit fullscreen false -> true (unsaved changes: 2)
revert -> volume 0.8, fullscreen false
edit and apply -> saved, unsaved changes: 0
```
hints: In ImGui, `ImGui::SliderFloat("Volume", &editor.edit().volume, 0, 1)` changes the edited copy straight away (lesson 2.01).
Put the Apply button between `ImGui::BeginDisabled(!editor.dirty());` and `ImGui::EndDisabled();` and it is greyed out and cannot be clicked while there is nothing to apply (lesson 3.01 covers it).
requirements: Keep the applied copy and the edited copy; the UI edits only the edited one.
`dirty()` compares them; `apply()` and `revert()` copy one over the other.
stretch: Count the changed fields one by one so the button can say "Apply 2 changes".
